fusions.name: Edict Peck
fusions.desc: Hands down a verdict that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds, plus 5% of the maximum health of a boss or elite it hits. Allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Sovereign Squawk
fusions.desc: Cries out, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Roll Call
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 25% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Deference
fusions.desc: Against a target below its full health, your damage rises 15%. Your dodge chance is also 5% higher at all times.
